look: Moonstone Cub, a E-rank GKOM variant from the Moonstone Ravagers family: playful bear cub with an owlish face and small moonstone claws. Family anatomy: hulking bear-like predators with owlish facial discs and moonstone claws. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: scattered small GKOM crystal clusters on shoulders and back; most of the body still natural; the crystals are milky moonstone. A golf-ball-sized GKOM core orb, cloudy amber, faint glow, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Water: aqua, deep blue and pearl accents, small subtle ribbons of water, bubbles and moonlit spray
